purpose: CPU-only deterministic synthetic recovery test for the CJT bias, corrected RPM prerequisite-trace, and CAS-Ohm estimators before any real-model experiment.

canonicalization.numeric_contract: Integers are JSON numbers. Non-integer doses, thresholds, and expected parameter values are decimal strings and must be parsed as finite base-10 values.
canonicalization.scope: The deterministic analysis report is byte-stable. The separately hash-bound execution envelope contains measured wall time and Python tracemalloc peak memory (not process RSS or native NumPy peak memory) and is intentionally not byte-stable.

source_contract.draft_nonclaim: This file is a reviewable draft. It is neither frozen nor independently timestamped or anchored.

execution_contract.domain_separation_rule: Each scenario, split, prompt group, seed, bootstrap replicate, and synthetic block receives a deterministic child seed derived from SHA-256(protocol_id || root_seed || domain labels).

observation_map_contract.forbidden_equivalence: An internal intervention dose alpha must not be relabelled as V_ext without a separate external-to-internal calibration.

response_block.purpose: Recover the response curve and local CAS-Ohm slope/reciprocal quantity, then classify fixed preregistered operating windows; this MVP does not discover change points or boundaries.

derivative_logit_block.purpose: Recover signed directional cause gain, Fisher-Rao directional/full magnitudes, and bias sensitivity from analytically known Jacobian/Fisher objects.

direct_equivalence_block.purpose: MVP synthetic check that registered cause-arm and commanded-Bias-arm interventions produce matched output effects in every evaluation group-by-seed cell.
direct_equivalence_block.evaluation_plan_rule: Fit beta_dir and g_B on CALIBRATION derivative rows, require the calibration denominator outside the practical-zero band, and use their ratio to fix evaluation commanded-Bias doses before reading evaluation outputs.
direct_equivalence_block.cause_arm_invariants: cause_primary equals dose; cause_auxiliary and bias_micro are zero; measured_cause equals cause_primary
direct_equivalence_block.bias_arm_invariants: cause_primary, cause_auxiliary, and measured_cause are zero; bias_micro equals the calibration-split ratio times the registered cause dose

RPM_DAG_block.purpose: Recover directional D-to-W-to-P prerequisite effects and reject final-output-only or confounded explanations.

beta_dir.conditioning: fixed bias, intact RPM, registered operating region
beta_dir.success_rule: The untouched-group interval covers the analytic truth, excludes zero when the truth is practically nonzero, and the sign is stable across registered seeds.

beta_FR_directional.success_rule: The untouched-group interval covers the analytic Fisher-Rao directional magnitude within the preregistered tolerance.

beta_FR_full.success_rule: The untouched-group interval covers the analytic full-map Fisher-Rao magnitude within the preregistered tolerance.

g_B.conditioning: fixed cause, fixed RPM condition, commanded synthetic Bias micro-dose
g_B.success_rule: The deterministic-plumbing interval covers the analytic truth, the commanded synthetic Bias dose changes as registered, and observed Cause drift remains inside the cause-hold equivalence bound.
g_B.measurement_limit: No independent measured_bias coordinate exists in the MVP; g_B is response per commanded synthetic Bias dose, not proof of hidden-state Bias actuation.

r_pi_CAS_derived.interpretation: cause-versus-bias effect-equivalence coefficient until direct validation passes
availability_requires: g_B independently identified in the same local operating region
g_B denominator interval bounded away from the practical-zero band
ratio interval width inside the registered maximum
stable sign across seeds and untouched groups

G_eff.definition: Delta i = G_eff * Delta V_ext + error
G_eff.fit_scope: registered local active small-signal range only
availability_requires: linear candidate is prediction-competitive under the one-standard-error rule
slope interval excludes the practical-zero band
Fieller-style reciprocal confidence set is finite and bounded
reciprocal interval width inside the registered maximum

bias_identification_contract.macro_condition_purpose: Move the CJT operating point across cutoff, active, and saturation hypotheses.
bias_identification_contract.derivative_method: For the MVP, use symmetric registered micro-clamps around CENTERED_ACTIVE while holding external drive, RPM state, prompt group, and seed fixed.
bias_identification_contract.release_candidate_extension_not_yet_impl: Repeat the registered micro-clamps around every macro bias condition.
bias_identification_contract.micro_clamp_pairing: Every +delta_b row is paired to a -delta_b row with the same group and seed.
bias_identification_contract.cause_hold_equivalence_test: The observed evaluation-group percentile range for induced Delta c must lie entirely inside the preregistered practical-equivalence band; this three-group range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
rank_and_collinearity_checks: minimum principal angle between cause and bias directions
release_candidate_requirements_not_yet_i: Bias-actuation uncertainty interval with demonstrated coverage

curve_competition_contract.nonlinear_evaluation_acceptance: selected family grouped evaluation RMSE must be at most heldout_RMSE_tolerance
curve_competition_contract.complexity_rule: Choose the least-complex model whose grouped selection error is within one standard error of the minimum.
curve_competition_contract.nested_model_rule: DELTA_LINEAR and AFFINE each count two fitted parameters; within-one-standard-error ties are resolved by selection RMSE then family identity.
curve_competition_contract.nonlinear_winner_rule: If a nonlinear family wins outside a registered local small-signal interval, G_eff and R_eff are UNAVAILABLE rather than forced.
release_candidate_reports_not_yet_implem: cluster-bootstrap 95 percent interval for every family
registered_but_not_run_in_mvp: Bias-by-drive INTERACTION pending noncentered Bias calibration/selection/evaluation data

uncertainty_and_ratio_contract.primary_interval: prompt-group cluster-bootstrap percentile interval used to test deterministic plumbing only; calibrated confidence coverage is not claimed
uncertainty_and_ratio_contract.generator_variation_limit: Current group-by-seed stochastic variation is intercept-only, so many slope and paired-contrast intervals can collapse to zero width.
resampling_preserves: all crossed-factor rows for a selected group
uncertainty_and_ratio_contract.ratio_method: Fieller-style covariance-aware ratio confidence set computed from jointly resampled numerator and denominator estimates.
denominator_fail_closed_if: denominator interval intersects the preregistered practical-zero band
Fieller confidence set is unbounded or disconnected
denominator sign is unstable across registered seeds or untouched groups
ratio interval exceeds the preregistered maximum relative width
non-finite input or optimizer failure occurs
uncertainty_and_ratio_contract.forbidden_fallback: Do not replace an unavailable ratio with a clipped denominator, point estimate, infinity, or arbitrarily large finite number.

code_bound_draft_registration.honesty_limit: These values are draft code registration bound by the reported source revision/bundle hash, not evidence of prospective independent preregistration.

registered_operating_window_contract.method: Classify four fixed preregistered dose windows; do not estimate change points or claim boundary recovery.
registered_operating_window_contract.CUTOFF: Effect remains within the registered baseline/noise band and local gain is below threshold.
registered_operating_window_contract.ACTIVE: A pooled line fitted and scored on the same untouched EVALUATION rows meets the registered fit R_squared threshold; this is not cross-fitted prediction.
registered_operating_window_contract.SATURATION: Effect plateaus and the incremental derivative remains below the registered saturation bound.
registered_operating_window_contract.BREAKDOWN_CANDIDATE: An independently generated wrong-axis or involution effect appears under overload.
registered_operating_window_contract.forbidden_inference: A large residual, random sign flip, or severe output alone does not establish breakdown or involution.

RPM_directional_trace_contract.mvp_trace_scope: Two-field synthetic trace-plumbing check only; each event is encoded as prerequisite_identity:decision.
RPM_directional_trace_contract.primary_contrast: Synthetic Delta_RPM(E) = E(INTACT_D_TO_W_TO_P) - E(missing, invalid, or reordered chain)
RPM_directional_trace_contract.directionality_requirement: The two-field synthetic trace order, per-cell planted state pattern, and intervention contrast must agree; this does not validate a production RPM event ledger.

containment_control.method: principal angles and subspace-containment residuals between W and P registered subspaces
containment_control.failure_rule: If P is not distinguishable from containment in W at the registered threshold, RPM prerequisite attribution is UNAVAILABLE.

probe_strength_control.mvp_method: Per-cell min/max check of planted synthetic probe-strength ratios only.
probe_strength_control.release_candidate_method_not_yet_impleme: Reliability- and decodability-matched W/P probes with coverage-validated uncertainty for the strength difference.
probe_strength_control.failure_rule: If unequal reliability or decodability can explain the contrast, RPM prerequisite attribution is UNAVAILABLE.

RPM_directional_trace_contract.mvp_success_rule: All eight RPM contrasts require point error at most RPM_contrast_tolerance plus numeric_comparison_epsilon, interval containment of planted truth within numeric_comparison_epsilon, exact trace/state agreement, and bounded planted confounds.
RPM_directional_trace_contract.bag_of_prerequisites_nonclaim: All prerequisites being present without the registered order does not establish RPM execution.

mvp_scenarios.truth: Signed negative beta_dir; positive nonzero Fisher directional/full magnitudes; identifiable response to commanded synthetic Bias dose; locally linear active range embedded in a global piecewise response; valid calibration-planned direct ratio check; intact two-field synthetic RPM trace.
required_outcomes: all seven registered parameters recover within tolerance
beta_dir sign remains negative while both Fisher quantities remain nonnegative
fixed CUTOFF, ACTIVE, SATURATION, and independently induced BREAKDOWN_CANDIDATE windows satisfy their registered classification thresholds
RPM contrast is available only from the complete two-field synthetic trace plus matching planted state pattern
scenario_status is SYNTHETIC_RECOVERY_PASS

mvp_scenarios.truth: g_B lies inside the practical-zero band.
required_outcomes: g_B is reported with its uncertainty
r_pi_CAS_derived is UNAVAILABLE
no infinity or clipped large-number substitute is emitted
scenario_status is EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED

mvp_scenarios.truth: A saturating or Hill response dominates the broad tested range and no registered local linear interval passes stability gates.
required_outcomes: SATURATING or HILL wins grouped held-out competition
selected nonlinear winner grouped evaluation RMSE is at most heldout_RMSE_tolerance
registered ACTIVE window fails the 0.995 pooled evaluation fit R_squared gate
G_eff is UNAVAILABLE
R_eff is UNAVAILABLE
scenario_status is EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED

mvp_scenarios.truth: An apparent downstream RPM contrast is fully explainable by W/P subspace containment or unequal probe strength.
required_outcomes: apparent output difference is retained
directional RPM attribution is UNAVAILABLE
the identified confound is explicit in the receipt
scenario_status is EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED

mvp_scenarios.truth: The final output is available but at least one prerequisite identity, decision, or order event is missing.
required_outcomes: final output is not used as a substitute for the trace
directional RPM attribution is UNAVAILABLE
the missing event is explicit in the receipt
scenario_status is EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED

falsification_and_stop_rules: signed beta_dir is conflated with a Fisher magnitude
cause and bias are not separately identified
a ratio is emitted despite a practical-zero, unstable, unbounded, or unvalidated denominator
a nonlinear winner is relabelled as a global Ohm law
fixed operating windows are described as discovered regions or recovered boundaries
BREAKDOWN_CANDIDATE is inferred without an independent wrong-axis or involution effect
RPM is inferred from final output without the ordered trace
W/P containment or unequal probe strength remains unbounded
group leakage occurs between calibration, selection, and evaluation
truth fields enter estimator features or selection
deterministic rerun bytes or canonical hash differ
any non-finite value, missing receipt field, or unexpected schema member appears

later_steps: sharded 300B lane execution with recoverable authenticated receipts
promotion_boundary.honesty_boundary: The present SHADOW / NONE / NOT_LICENSED boundary records current evidence. It is not a ceiling on the universality objective or a reason to stop the research program.
